title: Agent Skills SKILL.md frontmatter
description: Declarative spec for the YAML frontmatter of a SKILL.md file, per the Agent Skills open format (agentskills.io, verified 2026-07-12). This is the industry-standard replacement for superpowers:writing-skills / skill-creator as the RDL Phase-5 skill-authoring gate. Enforced in code by scripts/lint_skill.py (stdlib-only, no jsonschema dependency).

name.description: Unique kebab-case identifier. Must match evals.json skill_name.

description.description: What the skill does AND when to use it. Drives progressive-disclosure triggering.

license.description: Optional. Clarifies usage rights, e.g. Apache-2.0 or Source-available.
